tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm ivory by day, warm charcoal at night, with no grain (John, Nov 6; replaces beige paper and harbor navy).

tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, sheets, the tab bar. White by day, lifted charcoal at night.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Light stone. Sunken areas, your own row, input wells, avatars, the segmented control's track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo's brush. The one ink: all primary text, primary buttons, the brush ring, the painted ball, the app icon tile. Day 14.7:1 on paper; Night is ivory, 15.1:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, court and time, table headers. Day 7.0:1 on paper, 6.3:1 on sand; Night 7.9:1 on paper, 5.6:1 on sand.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text, icons and the painted ball sitting on an ink fill (primary button, active chip, the app icon's ball). 15.5:1 on ink in Day, 15.1:1 in Night.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card borders, table rules. One rule for every card and module: white linen fill with a 1pt hairline border, never borderless and never a shadow (John, Nov 7; lightened from 0.16 Day and 0.14 Night so borders read without feeling heavy). Borders over shadows, always.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). Meets 3:1 against paper and linen in both sessions (Day 3.33:1 on paper, 3.37:1 on linen; Night 3.54:1 and 3.39:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted-hc
tokens.usage: Replaces ink-muted when iOS Increase Contrast is on. 9.8:1 on paper in Day, 11.5:1 in Night.

tokens.name: hairline-hc
tokens.usage: Replaces hairline when Increase Contrast is on. Dividers and card borders become clearly visible (2.0:1 or better).

tokens.name: hairline-strong-hc
tokens.usage: Replaces hairline-strong when Increase Contrast is on. Control borders at 6.6:1 or better.

tokens.name: court
tokens.usage: Muted grass-court green, the only accent. Wins, confirmations, live matches, links. Text-safe on paper (7.5:1 Day, 8.3:1 Night), linen and sand in both sessions. White text on it 7.9:1. Use sparingly: most screens need none. Each job has its own non-color cue, because court is only 2.0:1 against ink text: inline links are underlined, live is the filled chip with its dot, wins carry a check.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and form errors only. Always paired with an icon or label, never color alone. 7.9:1 on paper in Day, 6.9:1 in Night. Court and danger share a lightness, so they must never be told apart by hue: wins carry a check, errors a cross.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px. Follows ink: navy by day, ivory at night.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heatmap, lowest bin. Heatmaps are one ink in five steps on sand, never a rainbow. Every bin also carries its count or percent as text, in ink on heat-1 and heat-2.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heatmap, second bin. Labels in ink.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heatmap, middle bin. Labels in on-ink from here up. Day is 0.60 so white labels clear 4.5:1 on the lighter stone sand (4.7:1).

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heatmap, fourth bin. Labels in on-ink.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Heatmap, highest bin: solid ink. Labels in on-ink.

styles.name: brush-l
styles.usage: Tab headers and big screen titles: league names, onboarding step titles, milestone titles. Echoes the roundel's lettering. Never below 28px, never for buttons, body, scores or small top-bar titles. Caps at 1.5x with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: brush-m
styles.usage: The title on a pushed detail screen (a league, a player, an invite), under its meta line. Approved screens, Nov 2026. Caps at 1.5x.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Screen heroes. One per screen. Caps at 1.5x with Dynamic Type, like every display style.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings and card titles (Next match, Standings, This season). Upright Cormorant, sized up to sit level with DM Sans (approved screens, Nov 2026).

styles.name: title-italic
styles.usage: The quiet flourish: empty states and celebrations. One line, sparingly, never for instructions.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Hero set scores. Always tabular lining figures.

styles.name: score-row
styles.usage: Set scores in match cards, score grids and score entry, and big stat values. Tabular lining figures (approved screens, Nov 2026).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mike confirmed for Saturday at Beacon Courts.
styles.usage: Default UI and reading text. Matches the iOS body size.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section labels over a list and stat keys (Past leagues, Your rank). Sentence case in ink-muted, replacing uppercase labels above lists (approved screens, Nov 2026).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and table headers only, never section labels over a list (those use section). Always uppercase. The heritage tag on a racquet throat. 11px is the iOS floor, so nothing you tap uses it: chips use chip.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Status tags that stay filled (You, Live, Rec). Always uppercase.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Plain pills: level, hand, format, status words. Sentence case, outline only, never filled (approved screens, Nov 2026).

styles.name: segment
styles.usage: Segmented control labels, at the iOS native 32pt control size, with each segment keeping a 44pt hit area (John, Nov 6).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section breaks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room. Be generous: restraint needs space.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, table cells, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Lists, score wells, inputs' wells and small panels.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card surface: match cards, stat tiles, list cards (John, Nov 5).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, plain pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only for things that float: sheets, menus, the toast. Cards use a hairline instead.
